name: print-social-digital-marketing-101-poster-cream-floating-figures-and-shapes
title: 'Digital Marketing 101' poster with cream floating flat-illustrated figures and abstract geometric shapes
whatItIs: A navy-bordered cream A4 poster with two flat-illustrated people floating weightlessly around a cluster of abstract shapes (a red arch, a navy sphere with a dark diamond, sparkle stars, dot rows), a bold headline 'Digital Marketing 101: Everything You Need to Know About Marketing', event date and a bit.ly link.
whatItMeans: Light and welcoming; floating figures around abstract shapes make a marketing webinar feel exploratory rather than dry.
techniques: Have illustrated figures float weightlessly around a shape cluster.
Mix simple geometric shapes (sphere, arch, diamond) as a decorative centrepiece.
Keep type minimal so the illustration leads.

vocabulary.definition: An illustrated person shown without ground contact, implying weightlessness.
Several abstract geometric forms grouped as one visual unit.
